pages.title: Moduli Ore
pages.text: Each crystal here is a snapshot of one possible shape for the hidden dimensions. Moduli are the dials that describe the size and shape of compactified space, and this ore holds those dials fixed in mineral form. Different veins, different geometries, all perfectly valid.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)String theory admits an enormous landscape of vacua, each set by its moduli. Mining the bulk, I noticed no two lumps of this ore refract light the same way. Each one has settled into a different vacuum.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Bulk (mine it for its drop).
